verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a commerce agent API could plausibly offer batch or bulk mutations. The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, though. The nearest items are adjacent features rather than bulk operations: multi-line-item carts, a waitlisted cross-merchant Universal Cart, catalog search seeded by a set of product IDs to find similar items, and paginated result sets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
